name: Mersevát (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and yellow in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mersevát: a blue shield with yellow ears of grain, a ploughshare and a coulter on a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
